title: NDP 2026: Showtime
description: The show is live. 40,000 in the stands, millions watching from home. Then the livestream starts buffering. You have 20 minutes before the fireworks finale. The whole nation is watching.
storyContext: The show is live. Millions streaming from home. Then the video starts freezing and social media blows up. 20 minutes to fireworks. The whole nation is watching.

software-engineer.title: Fix the Livestream
software-engineer.instruction: The stream is freezing for millions of viewers. 20 minutes to fireworks. What do you do?
software-engineer.hint: Something that works for everyone now beats a perfect fix that might fail halfway through. Think scale, not perfection.

options.label: Lower video quality. Smooth playback instantly, but the committee wanted top quality for the drone formation.
Spin up extra machines to share the workload. Uses 10 of your 20 minutes to set up, but quality stays perfect if it works.
Switch to a backup streaming network. Quick to activate, but you lose some viewer statistics.
Smart streaming — each viewer gets the best quality their connection can handle. Nobody freezes, but not everyone sees top quality.

data-scientist.title: Predict Viewer Drop-off
data-scientist.instruction: Viewers are leaving because the stream keeps freezing. The graph shows thousands still watching each minute. How many at the next check?
data-scientist.hint: Look at how much drops each minute. Is the drop steady, speeding up, or slowing down? Carry the pattern forward.

cloud-engineer.title: Spread the Load
cloud-engineer.instruction: Main system is overwhelmed. Spread traffic to backups in other locations. One mistake and the stream goes dark.
cloud-engineer.hint: Always check and prepare backups before sending traffic to them. Test with a small portion before going all-in.

items.label: Check that backup systems are healthy and ready
Update routing so traffic can reach multiple locations
Load the latest video content onto backups
Move 30% of traffic to backups as a test
Once stable, spread traffic evenly across everything
